answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable stake before it may take paid work, and publish every job result to a public mirror ledger that any peer can inspect. At the dawn of each epoch a falcon lottery picks a random sample of agents for a deep audit: auditors replay the claimed work and, if it is fake, the stake is slashed and the identity is burned. A Sybil operator must fund a stake for every copy, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn their deposit back with interest.
